about: Conference Guide catalogue. Hand-listed recurring conferences in India and worldwide. Months are the usual month and can move; the official site is the final word. Fields are described in README.md.

conferences.name: Bengaluru Tech Summit
conferences.desc: Karnataka's flagship technology event, covering IT, deep tech, biotech and startups, with an expo and policy sessions.

conferences.name: India Mobile Congress
conferences.desc: Asia's large telecom, media and technology forum, with launches from operators and handset makers.

conferences.name: Nasscom Technology and Leadership Forum
conferences.desc: The Indian IT industry's leadership gathering, on services, products and the policy that shapes them.

conferences.name: PyCon India
conferences.desc: The volunteer-run national conference for the Python programming language, with talks, workshops and sprints.

conferences.name: IndiaFOSS
conferences.desc: India's community conference on free and open source software and the people who build it.

conferences.name: The Fifth Elephant
conferences.desc: Practitioner conference on data engineering, machine learning and AI in production.

conferences.name: SEMICON India
conferences.every: Annual, host city has changed (New Delhi since 2025)
conferences.desc: Semiconductor manufacturing and design conference and expo, tied to India's chip programme. Earlier editions were in Bengaluru, Gandhinagar and Greater Noida.

conferences.name: Global Fintech Fest
conferences.org: Payments Council of India, NPCI and Fintech Convergence Council
conferences.desc: One of the world's largest fintech gatherings, on payments, digital public infrastructure and banking.

conferences.name: TechSparks
conferences.desc: Startup and tech summit bringing founders, investors and policymakers together.

conferences.name: Startup Mahakumbh
conferences.desc: National startup gathering with pavilions by sector, investor meetings and state showcases.

conferences.name: Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit
conferences.every: Every two to three years (2024, then 2027)
conferences.desc: Investment summit where companies and countries announce projects in Gujarat. The 2026 summit was replaced by regional conferences; the next global summit is January 2027.

conferences.name: Nullcon
conferences.desc: India's best-known hacker and security research conference, with trainings and a CTF.

conferences.name: c0c0n
conferences.desc: Cybersecurity and cybercrime conference that brings police, researchers and industry together.

conferences.name: International Conference on COMmunication Systems and NETworkS
conferences.desc: Peer-reviewed research conference on networking and communication systems.

conferences.name: ACM IKDD Conference on Data Science
conferences.desc: India's main research conference on data science. It was CODS-COMAD from 2018 to 2024.

conferences.name: IEEE International Conference on High Performance Computing, Data and Analytics
conferences.desc: Research conference on supercomputing, parallel systems and large-scale data.

conferences.name: Foundations of Software Technology and Theoretical Computer Science
conferences.desc: India's oldest computer science research conference, on theory and formal methods.

conferences.name: India Software Engineering Conference
conferences.desc: Research conference on how software is built, tested and maintained.

conferences.name: Aero India
conferences.desc: Asia's large aerospace and defence show, with flying displays at Yelahanka air base.

conferences.name: Bharat Mobility Global Expo
conferences.org: Engineering Export Promotion Council and industry bodies
conferences.desc: Mobility expo spanning cars, batteries, components and transport tech, now including the Auto Expo.

conferences.name: Indian Science Congress
conferences.desc: India's oldest science gathering. No session has been held since January 2023 after a funding dispute with the government, so check before planning.

conferences.name: India International Science Festival
conferences.org: Ministry of Science and Technology and Vijnana Bharati
conferences.desc: Science festival with conferences for researchers, students and the public.

conferences.name: Indian Academy of Sciences Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: Fellows' meeting with lectures across the sciences, open to students and teachers.

conferences.name: Astronomical Society of India Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The national meeting for India's astronomers and astrophysicists.

conferences.name: APICON
conferences.desc: The annual conference of India's physicians in internal medicine.

conferences.name: Cardiological Society of India Annual Conference
conferences.desc: India's largest cardiology meeting.

conferences.name: All India Ophthalmological Conference
conferences.desc: One of the world's largest eye care conferences.

conferences.name: All India Congress of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
conferences.desc: The national congress for obstetricians and gynaecologists.

conferences.name: PEDICON
conferences.desc: The national conference on child health.

conferences.name: Annual National Conference of the Indian Psychiatric Society
conferences.desc: India's main mental health conference.

conferences.name: ASICON
conferences.desc: The annual conference of India's surgeons.

conferences.name: BioAsia
conferences.desc: Life sciences and pharma forum in India's vaccine and drug-making hub.

conferences.name: CPHI and PMEC India
conferences.desc: Pharmaceutical ingredients and machinery expo with a conference track.

conferences.name: India Design ID
conferences.desc: Design and interiors week with talks, showrooms and new Indian studios.

conferences.name: UXINDIA
conferences.desc: Long-running user experience conference with workshops and talks.

conferences.name: India Energy Week
conferences.org: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
conferences.desc: Energy summit and expo on oil, gas, hydrogen and the energy transition. The host city has moved between Goa and New Delhi.

conferences.name: World Sustainable Development Summit
conferences.desc: TERI's summit on climate, sustainability and development, from the Global South.

conferences.name: Raisina Dialogue
conferences.org: Observer Research Foundation and Ministry of External Affairs
conferences.desc: India's flagship conference on geopolitics and geoeconomics.

conferences.name: Kautilya Economic Conclave
conferences.org: Institute of Economic Growth and Ministry of Finance
conferences.desc: Economic policy conference on growth and the Global South.

conferences.name: India Today Conclave
conferences.desc: Ideas conference with political leaders, business heads and cultural figures.

conferences.name: Indian History Congress
conferences.desc: India's largest gathering of historians.

conferences.name: Indian Economic Association Annual Conference
conferences.desc: The national conference of India's economists.

conferences.name: All India Sociological Conference
conferences.desc: The annual conference of the Indian Sociological Society.

conferences.name: Indian Engineering Congress
conferences.desc: Engineering congress across civil, mechanical, electrical and newer disciplines.

conferences.name: CES
conferences.desc: The world's largest consumer technology show, where gadgets and chips for the year are unveiled.

conferences.name: MWC Barcelona
conferences.desc: The mobile and telecom industry's main annual show.

conferences.name: Web Summit
conferences.desc: Huge tech and startup conference with founders, investors and policymakers.

conferences.name: SXSW
conferences.desc: Festival and conference where technology, film, music and culture overlap.

conferences.name: Google I/O
conferences.desc: Google's developer conference, with Android, web and AI announcements.

conferences.name: Apple Worldwide Developers Conference
conferences.desc: Apple's developer conference, where the next versions of its operating systems are shown.

conferences.name: Microsoft Build
conferences.every: Annual; Seattle until 2025, San Francisco from 2026
conferences.desc: Microsoft's developer conference on Windows, Azure and AI tools.

conferences.name: AWS re:Invent
conferences.desc: The largest cloud computing conference, with AWS product launches.

conferences.name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon
conferences.desc: The Kubernetes and cloud native community conference, held in Europe, North America, India and elsewhere.

conferences.name: Computex
conferences.desc: Asia's main computer hardware show, where PC and chip makers launch products.

conferences.name: IFA Berlin
conferences.desc: Long-running consumer electronics and home appliance show.

conferences.name: GITEX Global
conferences.every: Annual; moved from October to December in 2026
conferences.desc: Large technology show with startup, AI and government tracks, held at Expo City Dubai from 2026.

conferences.name: Slush
conferences.desc: Student-run startup event that connects founders with investors.

conferences.name: VivaTech
conferences.desc: Europe's large startup and technology event.

conferences.name: FOSDEM
conferences.desc: Free, volunteer-run weekend of open source talks, with no registration.

conferences.name: PyCon US
conferences.desc: The largest Python conference, with tutorials, talks and sprints.

conferences.name: GDC Festival of Gaming
conferences.desc: The video game industry's professional conference, known as the Game Developers Conference until 2025.

conferences.name: SIGGRAPH
conferences.every: Annual, mostly in North America; SIGGRAPH Asia in December
conferences.desc: Computer graphics and interactive techniques, from research papers to film effects.

conferences.name: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
conferences.desc: The top research conference on human-computer interaction.

conferences.name: International Conference on Software Engineering
conferences.desc: The flagship research conference on software engineering.

conferences.name: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
conferences.desc: The largest machine learning research conference.

conferences.name: International Conference on Machine Learning
conferences.desc: One of the leading machine learning research conferences.

conferences.name: International Conference on Learning Representations
conferences.desc: Deep learning research conference with open peer review.

conferences.name: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
conferences.desc: The top computer vision research conference.

conferences.name: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
conferences.desc: The main research conference on natural language processing.

conferences.name: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.org: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
conferences.desc: Broad AI research conference across reasoning, learning and applications.

conferences.name: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
conferences.desc: The leading data mining and applied data science conference.

conferences.name: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
conferences.desc: One of the oldest AI research conferences.

conferences.name: NVIDIA GTC
conferences.desc: NVIDIA's conference on GPUs, accelerated computing and AI.

conferences.name: World Artificial Intelligence Conference
conferences.desc: China's largest AI conference and exhibition.

conferences.name: DEF CON
conferences.desc: The world's best-known hacker convention, with villages and contests.

conferences.name: Black Hat USA
conferences.desc: Security research briefings and trainings for professionals.

conferences.name: RSAC Conference
conferences.desc: The cybersecurity industry's largest conference and expo.

conferences.name: Chaos Communication Congress
conferences.desc: Hacker congress on security, privacy and technology in society, held between Christmas and New Year.

conferences.name: USENIX Security Symposium
conferences.desc: Leading academic security research conference.

conferences.name: AAAS Annual Meeting
conferences.org: American Association for the Advancement of Science
conferences.desc: Broad science meeting across disciplines, with public sessions.

conferences.name: AGU Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The largest Earth and space science meeting.

conferences.name: EGU General Assembly
conferences.desc: Europe's main geosciences meeting.

conferences.name: APS Global Physics Summit (March Meeting)

conferences.name: Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings
conferences.org: Council for the Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings
conferences.desc: Nobel laureates meet young scientists, by application, with Indian participants nominated through national bodies.

conferences.name: Society for Neuroscience Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The largest neuroscience meeting.

conferences.name: International Congress of Mathematicians
conferences.desc: Mathematics' largest meeting, where the Fields Medals are awarded. Hyderabad hosted it in 2010.

conferences.name: IAU General Assembly
conferences.desc: The world assembly of astronomers.

conferences.name: Falling Walls Science Summit

conferences.name: ASCO Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The largest cancer meeting, where major trial results are presented.

conferences.name: ESC Congress
conferences.desc: The world's largest cardiology congress.

conferences.name: AHA Scientific Sessions
conferences.desc: Cardiovascular science meeting with late-breaking trials.

conferences.name: ADA Scientific Sessions
conferences.desc: The main diabetes research meeting.

conferences.name: ESMO Congress
conferences.desc: Europe's main oncology congress.

conferences.name: RSNA Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The largest radiology meeting, with a growing AI showcase.

conferences.name: World Health Assembly
conferences.desc: The WHO's decision-making body, where health ministers set global health policy.

conferences.name: World Health Summit
conferences.desc: Global health strategy forum with governments, researchers and industry.

conferences.name: MEDICA
conferences.desc: The world's largest medical technology trade fair.

conferences.name: WHX Dubai (formerly Arab Health)
conferences.desc: Large healthcare exhibition and conference for the Middle East and South Asia.

conferences.name: International AIDS Conference
conferences.every: Every two years, host city changes

conferences.name: BIO International Convention
conferences.desc: Biotech industry's partnering convention.

conferences.name: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting

conferences.name: Annual Meetings of the IMF and World Bank
conferences.every: Annual; two years in three in Washington
conferences.desc: Finance ministers and central bankers meet on the world economy.

conferences.name: Milken Institute Global Conference
conferences.desc: Finance and policy conference on capital, health and growth.

conferences.name: Singapore FinTech Festival
conferences.desc: Large fintech event led by Singapore's central bank.

conferences.name: Money20/20
conferences.every: Annual, with Europe and Middle East editions
conferences.desc: Payments and financial services conference.

conferences.name: Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity
conferences.desc: The advertising and marketing world's festival and awards.

conferences.name: Dreamforce
conferences.desc: Salesforce's customer and developer conference.

conferences.name: TechCrunch Disrupt

conferences.name: TiEcon

conferences.name: Future Investment Initiative
conferences.every: Annual; the 10th edition moved from 2026 to October 2027
conferences.desc: Investment forum hosted by Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund.

conferences.name: Hannover Messe

conferences.name: Salone del Mobile.Milano (Milan Design Week)

conferences.name: Dutch Design Week

conferences.name: London Design Festival

conferences.name: Config

conferences.name: Adobe MAX

conferences.name: Design Indaba

conferences.name: OFFF Barcelona

conferences.name: Interaction

conferences.name: UN Climate Change Conference (COP)

conferences.name: Bonn Climate Change Conference

conferences.name: London Climate Action Week

conferences.name: World Water Week

conferences.name: Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week

conferences.name: Shangri-La Dialogue

conferences.name: UN General Assembly High-Level Week

conferences.name: Internet Governance Forum

conferences.name: Paris Peace Forum

conferences.name: Boao Forum for Asia

conferences.name: American Historical Association Annual Meeting

conferences.name: Association for Asian Studies Annual Conference

conferences.name: American Sociological Association Annual Meeting

conferences.name: APSA Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The main political science meeting.

conferences.name: American Anthropological Association Annual Meeting
conferences.desc: The world's largest anthropology meeting.

conferences.name: Bett UK
